status: preregistered before any increment-10 download, run or oracle on the 14B checkpoint

classification.capacity: installed or configured size (RAM, DIMM, MemTotal, volume size)
classification.observation: measured state at a stated time; may change
classification.estimate: derived by declared arithmetic or assumed; never reported as a measurement

amendment_policy.rule: protocol.json and the test inventory are never edited after freezing; changes are new files results/increment10/amendments/NNN-<slug>.json with reason, author, UTC time and the SHA256 of protocol.json and of the previous amendment
forbidden: widening a numerical threshold after any measurement
removing or renaming a required test

checkpoint.tokenizer: identical Git blobs to the verified local Qwen2.5-7B tokenizer (preflight 2.1)
checkpoint.destination: checkpoints/qwen2.5-14b-97e1e76 (internal ext4 on the WSL VHDX, physical volume C:)
checkpoint.integrity: SHA256 computed while streaming (acquire10) == official LFS digest; runtime full SHA at start of R1-R3; final re-hash with tools/integrity9.py

workload.decode_rule: greedy token from the runtime logits, fed back even if it is EOS (151643)
workload.runtime_change: none: inwime_runtime/ and src/ must equal base_commit

active_weights.class: estimate (derived from the official headers; recomputed by tools/protocol10.py)
active_weights.not_claimed: larger than host RAM + pagefile (51.7 GB): irrelevant, weights are file pages

no_changes: no .wslconfig, swap, pagefile, sysctl, drop_caches or Windows setting is modified

plan_bytes.class_: observation: unchanged Qwen2Runtime.minimum_plan on sparse copies of the official headers (preflight 3.1; re-run by test_increment10_fixture)

derivation.rule: VmPeak(14B) = VmPeak(7B, M9) + plan(14B) - plan(7B); same code path, so the remaining address space (interpreter, ctypes kernel, thread stack and arena) is unchanged
derivation.transient_observation: the I/O thread arena is created by mapping 2 x 64 MiB and trimming to an aligned 64 MiB: VmPeak may include a transient 64 MiB that VmSize never keeps. Structural pipeline overhead measured 72.9 MB on the 7B (M9) and 136 MiB on the fixture (2026-11-18, tests/test_increment10_limits.py)
derivation.why_384: at 256 MiB the pipeline keeps < 14 MB of address space, and the worst-case arena transient does not fit: a spurious MemoryError or a degraded arena, not a numerical error, would decide the run. 384 MiB keeps > 140 MiB (> 77 MiB in the worst case). RLIMIT_AS is a safety net, not the memory measurement: anon+kernel and VmHWM stay bounded at 256 MiB and the 2 GiB scope is the real limit

thresholds.rule: abs(err) <= atol + rtol*abs(ref) for every element; never widened

contracts.full64: gating: upstream graph with RMSNorm, RoPE and softmax in FP64 (profile 7/9)
contracts.stock_fp64: diagnostic: reported raw; an expected FAIL is never rewritten

coverage_full.also: argmax and top-10 of every position; upstream greedy equals the runtime continuation
coverage_full.kv_rule: the oracle K/V after the last call are compared element-wise; the runtime per-phase K/V (lengths 5,6,7,8) must be byte-identical prefixes of the final K/V

coverage_classes.rule: F is PASS only with FULL coverage on both gating contracts (tools/compare10.py)

numerical_contract.fp32_risk: if stock_fp32 fails while full64 passes, F is FAIL; per-layer threshold utilization reported

oracle10.independence: no InWiMe import (static test); only token IDs from the runtime
oracle10.head_policy: blocked F.linear is not bit-identical to a full one in general (BLAS tail kernels; fixture: FP32 1.9e-6, FP64 4.4e-15): stock_fp32 keeps the full FP32 head (3.11 GB), bit-identical by construction; the FP64 head is never materialized

equivalence.fixtures: bit identity with stock from_pretrained (residuals, K/V, FP32 logits); FP64 logits max |delta| <= 1e-9 with identical argmax (tools/check_oracle10.py)
equivalence.7b_components: embedding gather and final norm + head on the M9 captures (tools/equivalence10.py): executed 2026-11-18, PARTIAL coverage, see oracle10-7b-equivalence/
equivalence.7b_end_to_end_prerequisite: before any 14B oracle: oracle10 on Qwen2.5-7B with the M9 sequence and chunks against artifacts/increment9/oracle-*.npz. stock_fp32: logits, residuals and K/V bit-identical; full64/stock_fp64: residuals and K/V bit-identical, logits max |delta| <= 1e-9, identical argmax. Failure makes the corresponding 14B contract NOT PROVEN
equivalence.cost_estimate: about 7 min and 60 GB of reads per contract (M9 oracle wall time); estimate

fault_injection.fault: wrong SHA256 / file changed after open
mutations of attribution (W as C) and of criterion D (7B bytes, missing RAM, MemTotal as RAM)
space guard, interrupted transfer, ignored Range, wrong digest

rollback.repository: dedicated branch, additive files only; revert or abandon; no force push
rollback.download: .part retained for resume or removed only by acquire10 --clean-temporaries (owned files)
rollback.checkpoint: deletion (29.55 GB) is the owner's decision; C: measured after any deletion (sparse VHDX reclaim not proven)
rollback.runs: transient scopes with --collect; no residual units/processes; targeted eviction of experiment files only
rollback.evidence: sanitized at write time; a FAIL is never fixed by changing thresholds or runtime inside M10

io_protocol.cold_definition: C = cold guest: experiment files evicted (POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED) and residency <= 1 % per shard by fincore before start. Not cold NAND: Windows, controller and SSD caches are not controlled; L4 shows whether the host could have served the reads
io_protocol.warm_definition: W = as-is immediately after a C run; informative, never used for C/D

counters.L4: Windows physical disk raw read counter (global)
counters.io.stat: not available: io controller not delegated (declared)

attribution_rules: L1 >= 0.90 * L0 on inference and every decode of a C run
delta L4 >= 0.90 * L1 when readable (global counter: never equality)
host PagesInput sustained > 2048 pages/s during a run: I/O attribution of that run is invalid (condition C NOT PROVEN for it); numerical results kept
records: temperatures NOT MEASURED unless readable without elevation

host_memory_preflight.baseline: a hostmem10 report taken at the start of the campaign session, before the first run; every later start check passes it as --baseline

verdicts.GO: every start criterion measured and satisfied
verdicts.DEFER: a measured value violates a start criterion: postpone, record blocked-host-memory-*.json
verdicts.NOT MEASURED: a required value is unreadable: do not start (BLOCKED with cause)

host_memory_preflight.observation_2026_11_18: host AvailableBytes 0.65-1.03 GB at rest: runtime and oracle profiles would be DEFER; the 7B component checks (peak RSS 3.8 GB in a 4.5 GiB scope) raised the pagefile from 7089 to 8639 MiB. A first hostmem10 revision launched one powershell.exe per sample and counted its start-up page-ins in the interval (8456 pages/s observed); the frozen revision takes both samples in one process (superseded reports kept in preflight-tooling/superseded-before-refreeze/)
host_memory_preflight.sampling: one powershell.exe process takes both samples (Start-Sleep inside), so its start-up is not counted in the paging rates; guest values are read just before and just after it
host_memory_preflight.class: thresholds are policy decisions (estimates), not measured capacities

space.note: the ext4 VHDX free space (892 GB apparent) is never used for decisions; C: is the physical limit

verdicts.PASS: every required fact present, typed and recomputed from raw data
verdicts.FAIL: a fact contradicts the criterion, or invalid JSON / wrong field type
verdicts.NOT PROVEN: evidence or field missing, or partial coverage, after the attempt
verdicts.BLOCKED: not attempted because of an external precondition recorded in blocked-*.json with cause and UTC time: download not authorized, space below threshold, host DEFER/NOT MEASURED, mount missing
verdicts.mixed_rule: a missing field and a contradicted field in the same check give FAIL (Issue #22 residual)

gate_conditions.A: integrity: acquisition SHA, runtime start SHA (R1-R3) and final re-hash equal the pinned LFS digests
gate_conditions.B: memory: 2 GiB scope, swap 0, memory.peak <= limit, oom = oom_kill = 0, anon+kernel <= 256 MiB, VmSwap 0, RLIMIT_AS per mode recorded
gate_conditions.C: I/O attribution rules on R1-R3; residency <= 1 % after eviction
gate_conditions.D: unique bytes from counters > max(TotalPhysicalMemory, DIMM) measured in the same run, and > MemTotal, equal to the header recomputation, on a C run that really read
gate_conditions.E: prefill 5 + 3 decodes, 48 layers, 579 tensor counters = shape x 8 (embedding rows exact), gemv coefficients for 8 positions, KV 5/6/7/8, sync/pipeline digests identical
gate_conditions.F: stock_fp32 and full64 PASS on FULL coverage, oracle10 7B end-to-end equivalence PASS, stock_fp64 raw
gate_conditions.G: every run supervised, no unattributed OOM, guest swap growth <= 256 MiB, host recorded (L4b)
gate_conditions.H: pinned inventory verified on the archived JUnit (tools/inventory10.py verify), gates 7/8/9 PASS, inwime_runtime/ and src/ unchanged since base_commit, no pre-existing file modified

stop_conditions: decode above 80 s/token: pause, investigate thermals and I/O
guest MemAvailable < 768 MiB: cgroup.kill of the scope only; run invalidated and kept
host AvailableBytes < 300 MB for more than 10 s: pause, annotated
host pagefile growth > 4 GiB since baseline: pause, annotated
C: free < 40 GiB during acquisition: stop, .part retained
no repetition until pass: every run, red or pilot, is kept
